discovery.geography: Ukraine and international markets on every inhabited continent: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Oceania; no Ukraine-only or EU-only source restriction.
discovery.source_registry_status: TARGET_NOT_AUDITED; do not claim 101 sources are connected until an actual deduplicated, accessible and checked registry exists.
discovery.example_media: InVenture (Ukraine); use only after verifying its actual domain, publication, source and relevance.
discovery.verification: For factual project claims trace secondary media to an authoritative primary announcement or official filing. Deduplicate syndications; never invent, imply a crawl, or count unchecked domains as verified sources.
discovery.editorial_scope: Industrial energy and generation, metallurgy, food, logistics, data centers, chemical, agriculture, pharma and waste, including relevant financing and implementation technologies.

homepage_news.selection: Five most recent approved, verified and dated articles; sort by publication_date descending, then stable slug. Never fill a shortfall with unverified or invented news. All approved articles remain accessible through the full news listing.

company_context.executive_quote: Only reproduce a verbatim quotation when present in a verified primary source; include speaker full name, position and source URL. Otherwise use a factual third paragraph without a quotation. Never invent quotations, credentials, project dates or status.

approved_image_selection_order: Inspect the original primary-source news article and its accompanying photograph or media kit for EVERY news item, not just items missing an image.

If the primary source provides a relevant photo and its documented license, press/editorial-use terms or written authorization permits the intended IIG publication, use that actual primary-source photo as the first choice, correctly credited.
If no suitable source photo is available or licensed, use the sector-matched image from the repository's baze_foto_news collection and manifest. Never substitute a different sector's image.

If the matched repository image is unavailable or fails to load, use another verified rights-cleared image of the SAME sector or original sector-specific artwork; log the missing asset and do not silently render an empty image slot.
images.repository_asset_gate: Before publishing, verify the archive or its extracted nine JPEGs and manifest really exist in the site repository and that each referenced file is included in the deployed output. A local archive or a filename in this policy is not proof that it was uploaded. Extract the ZIP into site-accessible individual JPEG files if only the archive exists; browsers must not use ZIP-member paths as image URLs.
images.source_photo_rule: Always inspect the accompanying photo at the primary-source article. A link or credit to the source at the end of the news article does not by itself grant photo republication rights. Record the actual license or applicable editorial permission and required credit; if unavailable, use baze_foto_news for that article's sector without delaying publication for an unlicensed source photo.
images.trademark_free_fallback: Repository sector images must be free of company names and logos, must be labelled as generated representative industry imagery, and must never be described as the actual facility in the article.
images.source_priority: The approved primary-source photo always takes precedence over baze_foto_news if the photograph is relevant, technically suitable and cleared for use; do not replace an approved source photo with a generic sector photo.
images.absolute_requirement: Every approved news article must display a relevant image on the homepage TOP-5, all-news feed, sector listing and full article. No old IIG ENERGY schematic, blank image slot, unrelated image or fabricated facility photograph.
images.rendering: Fit both source photos and baze_foto_news JPEGs into the existing responsive 16:9 media container; consistent card image heights, object-fit:cover for photos, suitable object-position and no distortion or excessive article hero height. Apply on homepage, all-news, sector listings and full article. Include factual bilingual alt text and caption and required photo credit.
images.error_fallback: On image load error, switch a source photograph to the corresponding verified local baze_foto_news sector JPEG; do not restore the deleted SVG placeholder. If the local image fails, report a release-blocking asset error and do not claim the page is ready.
images.release_gate: For all nine approved sector items verify primary-source image search and rights, correct source-photo-first or matching baze_foto_news selection, valid deployed URL, UA/EN alt and caption, and actual rendering in home, news, industry and article. Confirm five latest approved articles on the homepage. Never claim images are installed merely because this protocol mentions their filenames.

editorial.navigation: Every published card on home and industry pages links to the full approved article. No hardcoded demo news in public listings. Audit all nine sectors for coverage, valid routing and honest empty states.
